assets.label: Shieldwall Discipline
assets.subject: Three adult soldiers with longer natural legs, smaller heads and realistically scaled shields in a defensive formation.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Crown Lands skill icon draft.
Image 1: uploaded medieval atlas, PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE. Image 2: shieldwall draft, supporting reference for colors and subject only. The second image's anatomy and layout must be replaced.
Redraw THREE adult medieval human soldiers in a defensive formation. The user rejected the squat proportions. The group must be visibly TALLER THAN IT IS WIDE, with slender natural adult bodies. Each man has the proportions of a real tall adult standing upright: a small head, normal torso, long thighs and long shins, seven-and-a-half to eight anatomical head heights tall. Helmets must be SMALL and fitted to normal heads. Do not copy the second image's huge heads, huge shields, large boots or short-legged figures.
CRITICAL SCALE: each shield is only about ONE THIRD of its soldier's full standing height. Each soldier's long legs extend from hips at about the midpoint of his full height to feet at the bottom, with visible upper thighs, knees, shins and normal-sized boots. Shields must end at the UPPER THIGH, far above the knees; not at the knees or shins. Heads and helmets small enough to read as adult humans with realistic full-body proportions.
Three men standing upright shoulder to shoulder, center slightly forward, all looking toward one threat, feet firmly braced with only a slight knee bend. They hold THREE medium-sized heater shields together as an overlapping defensive line at chest-to-upper-thigh height. Left shield muted olive, middle restrained burgundy, right ochre; worn painted wood, dull iron rims and rivets. Their shoulders, arms, belts, lower tunics, upper thighs and long legs remain visible. Simple tunics, subtle chainmail neck/sleeves, steel helmets, practical brown boots. Exactly three men, three shields, six legs. No deep crouch or attack pose.
Composition: a taller, narrower whole group centered on a square transparent canvas, generous space to either side, about 80 percent canvas height and 60 percent width. Do not spread the men across the entire square. All heads and boots fully visible. The natural full-height silhouette and adult proportions take priority over large shield details.
Match the original atlas art: delicate dark-brown ink contours and fine etched hatching, subdued watercolor/gouache washes, paper-grain texture inside painted forms, muted earth tones, restrained olive/burgundy/ochre/slate. Hand-painted illustration with simple readable silhouettes, not chunky cartoon character art, not photorealism or 3D. Genuine transparent background. No scenery, ground, lettering, labels, frame, magic glow or watermark.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Crown Lands medieval strategy game skill icon draft.

The bay horse reaches its head dynamically forward toward the left, neck slanting back to the right, muzzle slightly down and forward, nostrils flared, ears alert. The dark mane is swept backward toward the right in several bold wind-blown flowing locks; forelock and bridle reins also sweep backward, visibly responding to movement. This is a static painted icon with an energetic pose.
